Cadryl native interface assets

Barlow Regular, Medium, SemiBold and Bold
Source: https://github.com/google/fonts/tree/6cdf01867df0813c2390f90dff7dc66c87f14cf7/ofl/barlow
License: SIL Open Font License 1.1; see OFL.barlow.txt.

Phosphor Duotone pictograms, selected native Compose vectors
Source: https://github.com/adamglin0/compose-phosphor-icon/tree/d83bea0a9ed83c38c91cb56e927381e1b2943db8
Artwork: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core
Licenses: MIT; see LICENSE.compose-phosphor-icon and LICENSE.phosphor.
Only vectors used by the interface are included. Arrow navigation enables
Android autoMirror. Unused icon families and AllIcons lists are omitted.
Upstream and installed hashes are recorded in manifest.json.
